integrity: Finite computational checks are supplementary to an analytic proof; literature inspection is not a guarantee against an unindexed equivalent theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers finite sets of positive indices for harmonic h^1 with boundary complex measures; quantitative distance is bounded-Lipschitz rather than total variation, constants depend on a Bezout certificate, and no independent validation is claimed.
title: Arithmetic rigidity and sharp stability of harmonic Hardy endpoint extremizers
